description: This Java class manages external login keys for single sign-on authentication within the OFBiz framework. It generates, validates, and cleans up external login tokens, facilitating user authentication across different applications or components.

classes.name: ExternalLoginKeysManager
classes.description: Manages external login keys for single sign-on, including generation, validation, and cleanup of tokens, and integrates with request and session handling.

methods.name: getExternalLoginKey
methods.description: Generates or retrieves an external login key for the request, creating a new UUID token if necessary, and associates it with the user login in the session and map.

methods.name: cleanupExternalLoginKey
methods.description: Removes the external login key from the internal map based on session data.

methods.name: checkExternalLoginKey
methods.description: Validates and processes the external login key provided in the request, ensuring the user is logged in accordingly.

methods.name: isExternalLoginKeyEnabled
methods.description: Checks if external login keys are enabled through configuration properties.
